notes.title: Improved Demo
notes.content:
This is new...

New Levels
We selected seven levels from the main game and added them to the demo as a teaser for the “Europe’24 Indie Cup”. We are pleased to be able to present you new content after almost a full year. :)

Improved graphics
We noticed that some of the graphics don't fit well with the rest of the game. So we recreated some of them and the game looks much clearer now.

Fixed difficulty
Some of you found the boss fight particularly difficult, so we've made some changes to the levels and the boss fight to make it work better with your chosen difficulty setting.

New boss fight
Not only did we change the difficulty of the boss fight, but we also redesigned the boss fight itself. Now attacks are clearer and combat is fairer for the player.

Have fun with our new free demo! :)
